data.name: Akhil
data.long_meaning: Akhil is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Akha' meaning 'entire' or 'whole'. It is a powerful name that signifies completeness and perfection. In Hindu mythology, Akhil is an epithet for Lord Vishnu, who is considered the preserver of the universe. The name is believed to bring good fortune, happiness, and success to the one who bears it.
